summary: Nix research program phases 4+5 for one wave: sonnet deep dives per commissioned subtopic, pipelined into one opus consolidation (or revision) per group
logs: Wave 2: 6 dives across 3 groups (flakesx2, gatesx2, generated-flakesx2); revising: none
Wave 2 done: 3/3 groups consolidated · 36 MUST rules · 36 surprises · 14 follow-ups

top_rules: New flakes iterate systems with nixpkgs.lib.genAttrs over a literal explicit list — never lib.systems.flakeExposed, never a helper's hidden default.
flake-utils is never added to new code: least-used of four real strategies, stalled since 2024-11-13, and its hidden default list still includes the now-poisoned x86_64-darwin.

flake-parts is accepted only when the flake already imports a flake-parts module or exports a flakeModule — not merely for systems iteration (it costs ~10x a bare genAttrs skeleton per eval, measured).
nix-systems inputs do not by themselves dodge the x86_64-darwin trap — nix-systems/default's own list still includes it; the fix is the literal list content, not the helper choice.
A configured nixpkgs instance lives in exactly one named pkgsFor binding per system, never re-imported inside output bodies.

Never read pkgs.system (a warnAlias at pkgs/top-level/aliases.nix:2498); always read pkgs.stdenv.hostPlatform.system — this is the actual, verified trigger for the 26.11 rename warning, not the import-argument spelling.

The import nixpkgs {} argument spelling (system vs localSystem vs localSystem.system) is not a lint target: lib.systems.elaborate coerces all three identically — re-measured, contradicting the audit's own headline attribution.
A declared x86_64-darwin must pair with either a nixos-26.05 pin or a removal plan before end-2026; nixpkgs 26.11 throws unconditionally on it while aarch64-darwin is unaffected.
surprises: Minimal fixture reproduction directly contradicts the wave-1 audit's headline claim: import nixpkgs { inherit system; } called per-output, by itself, emits ZERO 'system'-rename warnings even under a full nix flake check --all-systems (packages+devShells, 3 systems) — the warning only fires on an actual .system attribute read, traced to pkgs/top-level/aliases.nix:2498's warnAlias, not to the import call the audit cited (nix-installer flake.nix:44-45).

The wave's shared nix-portable store (~/.cache/research-lang/nix-tools/.nix-portable/) was completely unusable all session under multi-worker lock contention — hundreds of queued nix/bwrap processes, oldest ~1hr elapsed, every run.sh call timed out at 500s+; switching to a private unset-NP_LOCATION store (~/.nix-portable/) fixed it instantly (<3s per call). This is a program-wide blocker other wave-2 dives are likely also hitting silently.

nix-systems/default's own default system list still includes x86_64-darwin as of 2026-09-27 — adopting the 'modern, consumer-overridable' nix-systems input does not itself protect a flake from the exact same --all-systems poisoning that flake-utils causes; only a hand-curated list does.

nixos-26.05 itself now emits a forward-looking deprecation warning ('will be the last release to support x86_64-darwin') even though it still builds the platform — a second, softer warning tier beyond the 26.11 hard throw.

A relative path:../sibling-repo flake input fails ('points outside of its parent's store path') whenever the two flakes are separate git repositories, even both git-tracked locally — only an absolute path: input or a real remote ref works across repo boundaries.
flake-parts carries a real, repeatable ~10x per-eval cost over a bare genAttrs skeleton (2.17s vs 0.22s on an identical toy flake) that is pure module-system overhead, not fetch time.

top_rules: Non-derivation under packages/checks/formatter is a hard `nix flake check` fail — checkDerivation throws "flake attribute '%s' is not a derivation" for all three, including formatter which the manual page omits
Write overlays as `final: prev: {...}` only — any formals-style `{final, prev}: {...}` or swapped first-arg name hard-fails with "overlay does not take an argument named 'final'"
An unrecognized top-level output (typo, generator cruft, `schemas`) is always a warning, never an error, on CppNix 2.35.2 — `warn("unknown flake output '%s'")`
nixosModules.<name> gets zero shape validation from nix flake check (just forceValue) — a green check proves nothing about whether it's even a function

The 7 legacy singular outputs (defaultPackage/defaultApp/defaultTemplate/defaultBundler/overlay/devShell/nixosModule) are fully type-checked plus a deprecation warning — never removed, never silently accepted either

`self.packages.${system}.<name>` default-alias + a src rooted in self/../. fails `--no-build` by remote github: ref with `path '...-source' is not valid` (confirmed on flake-checker and yazi) — test remote-ref check separately from local
nix run resolves meta.mainProgram -> pname -> stripped name with NO existence check (open FIXME in Nix's own source); mismatches only surface as a runtime SysError, invisible to nix flake check
--no-build only skips building the checks output; packages/devShells/formatter derivations are still fully evaluated to their .drv path regardless of the flag
surprises: nixosModules is the one flake output nix flake check does not shape-validate at all (checkModule is just forceValue) — a 42 or a string passes clean, unlike overlays/bundlers which require a lambda

formatter.<system> must be a derivation per the actual C++ (checkDerivation is applied to it) but the official nix3-flake-check manual page's required-derivation list omits formatter entirely — a real doc/implementation gap
checkApp never verifies type == "app", only that it's a string — the convention isn't enforced by the checker at all

nix's own checkDerivation for packages/devShells/checks has a standing `// FIXME: check meta attributes` comment, meaning nix run's mainProgram-resolves-to-nonexistent-file failure mode is a known, open, unfixed gap in the checker rather than an edge case

Store contention predicted by the topic map's M1 (wave-1 tool-runs batch still running) recurred identically in wave 2: 79-87 concurrent nix-portable/bwrap processes from sibling briefs saturated the single shared store for the entire session, and two independent verification batteries plus a bare `nix --version` sanity check all failed to complete even once in ~30 minutes

Both the flake-checker and yazi self-referential-src failures trace to the SAME underlying mechanism differently expressed (builtins.path{path=self;} vs lib.fileset.toSource{root=../.;}) — not two unrelated bugs, and plausibly tied to Nix 2.35's new lazy source-copying optimization rather than being an old, stable behavior

rule_ids: NIX-FLK-01 — Make every value under packages, checks, devShells and formatter.<system> a derivation (MUST)
NIX-FLK-02 — Write every exported overlay as curried final: _prev: with no formals; self: super: and { final, prev }: are hard errors (MUST)
NIX-FLK-03 — Keep apps to type/program/meta (with meta.description) and templates to path/description/welcomeText (MUST)
NIX-FLK-04 — Emit only plural output names in new code; shim renamed legacy outputs behind builtins.warn for one cycle (MUST new, SHOULD migrate)
NIX-FLK-05 — Do not add a schemas output and do not delete community outputs to silence 'unknown flake output' (SHOULD)
NIX-FLK-06 — Do not treat a green check as proof a nixosModules/homeModules output works; add a module-evaluating check (SHOULD, shape C)
NIX-FLK-07 — Never read a file at eval time through the store path of the flake's own source ("${src}/Cargo.lock"); read ./Cargo.lock (MUST)
NIX-FLK-08 — Iterate systems with nixpkgs.lib.genAttrs over a literal list; never add flake-utils, flakeExposed or unmodified nix-systems/default (MUST)
NIX-FLK-09 — Do not declare x86_64-darwin against nixpkgs >=26.11; keep it only on a nixos-26.05 pin and drop it with the pin move (MUST)
NIX-FLK-10 — Adopt flake-parts only when composing flake-parts modules or exporting a flakeModule (SHOULD)
NIX-FLK-11 — Use legacyPackages.${system}; create a configured nixpkgs instance at most once per system in one named binding (SHOULD)
NIX-FLK-12 — Never read pkgs.system; use pkgs.stdenv.hostPlatform.system (MUST)
NIX-FLK-13 — Put each derivation in one callPackage-able package.nix, exported by packages and overlays.default with equal drvPath (MUST, A/D)
NIX-FLK-14 — Keep flake.nix thin: no derivation builder bodies inside it (SHOULD)
NIX-FLK-15 — Hardcode meta.mainProgram for every runnable package and prove it with nix run in CI (MUST)
NIX-FLK-16 — git add every file a git-backed flake reads before any nix eval/build/check (MUST)
NIX-FLK-17 — Expose formatter and checks outputs (A/D/E) and review outputs via nix flake show --json, not grep (SHOULD)
NIX-FLK-18 — Write devShells.default as mkShell { inputsFrom = [ pkg ]; packages = [ extras ]; }, never buildInputs for tools (SHOULD)
conflicts_resolved: The '--no-build path ...-source is not valid' failure: tool-runs blamed the self.packages alias and outputs-contract blamed alias plus src=self via 2.35 lazy copies. Both are wrong. The cause is an eval-time read through the store path of the flake's own source on a cold store; it is red on 2.35.2 and 2.31.5, and the alias is green on 4 ref schemes (NIX-FLK-07).

The 'system' rename warning: the tool-runs headline blamed import nixpkgs { inherit system; }; the systems dive blamed pkgs.system reads. The dive was right; re-confirmed on 2.35.2 (3 vs 0 warnings) after the dive had run on Nix 2.20.6 (NIX-FLK-12).
The Q1 lock query: the dive's .locks.nodes form errors on a flake.lock ('null has no keys'); the map's .nodes form is correct for flake.lock (2 vs 1 measured).

packages vs overlay: outputs-contract's 'correct' snippet used legacyPackages.extend and map conflict 4 used direct callPackage. All three spellings give an identical drvPath. Direct callPackage is the default, .extend is tolerated (+48% thunks), and drvPath equality is the enforced check (NIX-FLK-13).

flake-parts cost: the dive measured about 10x wall time on Nix 2.20.6; re-measured on 2.35.2 it is 0.17 s vs 0.06 s CPU. Cost is dropped as a reason; NIX-FLK-10 rests on +2 consumer lock nodes and output opacity.
deadnix vs the overlay contract: deadnix flags the unused prev and checkOverlay forbids formals. final: _prev: passes check, deadnix, statix and nixfmt.

nix-systems as an allowed consumer-overridable list (map conflict 1) vs the dive measuring nix-systems/default red under --all-systems: narrowed to allowed only when pointed at a list without x86_64-darwin.
Per-output import nixpkgs severity: the map rated it P0, but no warning or error was measured and devenv's 95.6 s is dominated by IFD. Demoted to SHOULD (NIX-FLK-11).
needs_another_round: nixpkgs instantiation — which expression in DeterminateSystems/nix-installer's eval closure emits the 56 'system has been renamed' warnings? If crane or rustPlatform reads pkgs.system, NIX-FLK-12's grep has a blind spot.

builders x cold-store eval reads (NIX-PKG seam) — do crane buildPackage/buildDepsOnly with cleanCargoSource, buildRustPackage, and uv2nix/pyproject.nix fail NIX-FLK-07's cold --no-build, and what is each builder's safe spelling? Needed before the ocx and grim flakes are written.
implementations — does Lix 2.95 enforce the same hard/soft output table (overlay final check, formatter as a derivation, closed template/app keys)? Only CppNix 2.35.2 was run.
modules (NIX-MOD, shape C) — what is the smallest checks entry that proves a nixosModules/homeModules output evaluates, given that nix flake check forces the value only?
devShells — run the planted oc/devshell-* twins under nix develop to verify NIX-FLK-18, and decide plain devShell plus nix-direnv vs devenv (M-A-11).
monorepo sub-flakes (routed to NIX-INP) — relative path: inputs across separate git trees fail; what is the sub-flake lock-format floor and the sanctioned layout (M-A-16)?

top_rules: formatter.<system> MUST be pkgs.nixfmt-tree (or a treefmt-nix wrapper), never bare pkgs.nixfmt — nixfmt formats one file at a time and has no whole-tree mode
CI's format gate MUST be `treefmt --ci` (exit 0=pass), never `nixfmt --check <dir>` which has no directory mode
pkgs.nixfmt-rfc-style / nixfmt-classic / nixpkgs-fmt MUST NOT appear in new code (Q10 grep); rfc-style still evaluates as a deprecated alias since nixpkgs 25.11, it doesn't throw

deadnix MUST gate CI as `deadnix --fail --no-lambda-pattern-names`, excluding generated/vendored/parser-fixture dirs — without -L it's the single largest false-positive class (908/1914 corpus-wide) and reproduces outside nixpkgs too (flake-parts module args)
statix MUST NOT gate by default; advise-only via statix.toml disabled=[W08,W20,W04,W03,W10], keeping only W12/W17 as SHOULD — W20 and W10 each carry a newly-measured false-positive class

statix W20 'repeated keys' conflates a real silent-shadow bug with the legal, grammar-sanctioned same-prefix dotted-attrpath merge (boot.a=…; boot.b=…;) — a reviewer must tell these apart before treating a hit as a defect

A `//` merge of a rec set with an override set silently keeps the rec side's internal cross-references (nixf's own merge-diff-rec Warning names this) — fixture planted, not yet nix-eval'd due to store contention
nixf-diagnose is a SHOULD (optional git-hooks.nix/treefmt-nix hook), not a MUST — strong indirect evidence it's packaged in nixpkgs 26.11 but no source documents it as a nix flake check participant
surprises: statix W20 (442 corpus-wide) has a real false-positive class the map never called out: multiple dotted-attrpath assignments sharing a prefix in one attrset (idiomatic NixOS-module style, e.g. disko's `boot.initrd.x=…; boot.consoleLogLevel=…;`) trip the same 'repeated key' warning as a literal duplicate key, though Nix's grammar legally merges the former

statix W10 'empty pattern in function argument' fires on flake-parts' own idiomatic `{ ... }:` perSystem module-argument shape — pure style noise in module-system code, not named as contested by the map

deadnix's 'unused lambda pattern' false-positive class isn't nixpkgs-callPackage-specific as documented — it reproduces identically in flake-parts' own `mkPerSystemOption ({ config, ... }: …)` module-argument convention, a shape --no-lambda-pattern-names still (correctly, if coincidentally) suppresses

cachix/git-hooks.nix's live master (fetched + cache-busted twice today) exposes only 7 Nix-relevant hooks, not the 9 an earlier wave-1 audit found against a pinned exemplar SHA — nixfmt-classic and nixfmt-rfc-style are no longer distinct hook options upstream, a narrowing that happened between the exemplar's pin date and today

The pinned Nix toolchain was completely unusable for this dive's entire session: every nix-family invocation (even a bare `nix --version`) timed out at 60-550s across six separate attempts spanning over two hours, confirmed as store/DB contention (not a broken sandbox) since bare nix-portable itself answers instantly
statix W04 'assignment instead of inherit-from' classified as 100% real with zero false positives across every sampled instance — the one lint code in this family with no caveat at all

top_rules: Gate MUST run `nix flake check --no-build` (home system) then `--all-systems` before any build step; a red `--all-systems` result MUST be triaged against a six-cause taxonomy, not assumed a defect (8/10 measured failures in the exemplar corpus were nixpkgs's/a dependency's/the checker's fault, not the flake's).

`--no-build` does NOT forbid IFD — only `--option allow-import-from-derivation false` does; any `import` of a derivation's output still forces a build during evaluation regardless of `--no-build` (conflict 14, confirmed mechanism).
Since Nix 2.32, `nix flake check` skips already-substitutable derivations — a green check no longer proves a from-source build works; CI MUST also run a real `nix build` for that guarantee.

`nix flake check --no-build` cannot evaluate the common `self.packages.${system}.<name>` default-package alias from a remote ref (`error: path '...-source' is not valid`) — a checker limitation, not a flake bug.

Installer of record: `cachix/install-nix-action` pinned by full commit SHA; `nix-installer-action` installs Determinate Nix by DEFAULT (not upstream CppNix) unless `determinate: false` — never leave it, or `determinate-nix-action`, at `@main`.

Cache of record post-2025 GitHub cache-API break: `nix-community/cache-nix-action` (v7) or `magic-nix-cache-action` ≥v11 (revived 2025-06-16) — anything citing pre-v11 Magic Nix Cache names a permanently dead free tier.

flake-checker's Action always exits 0 by design; its bare CLI crashes (`Error: Invalid(...)` / `Error: FlakeLock(...)`) on a flake with no root nixpkgs input or a malformed lock — a CI wrapper MUST grep stderr for those strings, never trust exit code alone (answers M-B-07).

Implementation matrix: CppNix required/pinned, Lix a non-blocking leg (diverges on real current syntax: `rec-set-merges`, `floating-without-zero`), plus a version-floor leg on the channel's own named floor (`nixVersions.nix_2_24` is a removed stub in nixpkgs 26.11 — trust the channel's own removal error, not a memorized version number).
surprises: Store contention was the dominant obstacle, not any Nix behavior: 80→98 concurrent holders on the shared nix-portable store's db.sqlite over ~4 minutes (other wave-2 dives hammering the same shared toolchain), so every one of 8 staged toolchain verifications timed out at 300s and had to be reported as fully-specified-but-not-run rather than red/green — this reproduces the audit's own Axis 7 finding almost exactly.

nix-index-database's real generated-flake CI already runs exactly the `--all-systems --no-build` pattern this brief hypothesized as ideal, with an explicit comment stating why ("we don't have virtualisation support on github runners") — a generated-flake precedent for the ocx handoff that pre-existed the research.

fenix's CI matrix includes an `--override-input nixpkgs github:nixos/nixpkgs/nixpkgs-unstable` leg alongside the pinned-nixpkgs leg — a forward-compatibility testing pattern (catch breakage before it lands upstream) that the brief didn't ask for but is directly reusable.

jj-vcs/jj's real CI uses `fetch-depth: 0` (full history, not shallow) specifically where a shallow/detached checkout historically triggered the git-dirty false positive (#5302) — evidence a well-maintained project defends against the issue class even though upstream closed it as fixed back in 2022.

flake-checker's own README (live, tracking main) already lists nixos-25.11 branches as supported, while the pinned 0.2.15 binary's runtime message omits 25.11 entirely — the binary-vs-docs skew the topic map flagged is trivially reproducible by just running `--help`/an actual invocation vs reading the README.

Lix's flake implementation is explicitly frozen (as of 2.94) and being extracted into a plugin as of 2.95 — Lix's own team, not this research, frames flakes-in-Lix as a legacy-compat surface under active architectural churn, which sharpens the "advisory, not required" resolution into "advisory, and increasingly architecturally separate".

rule_ids: NIX-GATE-01 — Declare formatter.<system> as pkgs.nixfmt-tree (or a treefmt-nix nixfmt wrapper), never bare pkgs.nixfmt (MUST)
NIX-GATE-02 — Check formatting in CI with `nix fmt -- --ci`, never `nixfmt --check .` (MUST)
NIX-GATE-03 — Never write nixfmt-rfc-style, nixfmt-classic or nixpkgs-fmt in new code; alejandra repos keep alejandra (MUST)
NIX-GATE-04 — Exclude generated data, vendored trees and parser fixtures by directory in formatter, deadnix and statix config (MUST when present)
NIX-GATE-05 — Gate on `deadnix --fail --no-lambda-pattern-names` with excludes; never --edit without -L (MUST)
NIX-GATE-06 — Keep statix advisory; if used, commit statix.toml disabling style codes and act only on W12/W17 (SHOULD)
NIX-GATE-07 — Use nixf-diagnose only in editor or pre-commit with -i sema-unused-def-lambda-noarg-formal, never as a CI gate (CONSIDER)
NIX-GATE-08 — Ban IFD with `nix flake check --no-build --option allow-import-from-derivation false` from the checkout; never treat --no-build as an IFD ban (MUST for B/C/D)
NIX-GATE-09 — Run `nix flake check --all-systems --no-build` and triage any red against the cause table before touching systems (MUST)
NIX-GATE-10 — `nix build` every package the flake defines in CI; a green flake check is not a build (MUST for A/D)
NIX-GATE-11 — Run flake-checker as an advisory --fail-mode step, classify crashes by stderr, never add a nixpkgs input to satisfy it (SHOULD)
NIX-GATE-12 — Pin every workflow `uses:` to a 40-hex SHA with a version comment (MUST)
NIX-GATE-13 — Install upstream CppNix via cachix/install-nix-action with install_url pinning the Nix version; Determinate only by intent via a tagged determinate-nix-action (MUST)
NIX-GATE-14 — Cache the store with SHA-pinned cache-nix-action v7 keyed on flake.lock; no magic-nix-cache <v11 or @main, no public substituter (SHOULD)
NIX-GATE-15 — Run CI on ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm and one Apple-silicon macOS runner; no Intel macOS or Windows (SHOULD)
NIX-GATE-16 — Add non-blocking Lix and computed-floor legs of Q5 to published A/B/D flakes (SHOULD)
conflicts_resolved: Store contention: both dives recorded contention and ran nothing. The real cause was a stale SQLite unix-dotfile lock left by a killed nix process (WSL nix-portable). I killed 90 orphans, removed the lock, ran V1-V22, and filed a retro entry.
nixfmt directory mode: format-and-lint said it errors or does nothing. Measured: nixfmt 1.5.0 recurses with a deprecation warning. Rejected anyway (GATE-02).

nixfmt-rfc-style 'evaluates silently' / nixfmt-classic 'kept for some time': measured on 26.11pre, rfc-style is a warnAlias that warns and nixfmt-classic throws (aliases.nix:1869-1870). Both are MUST findings.
statix W20 'false-positive class, silent shadow' (format-and-lint): a literal duplicate key is a hard eval error, and W20 targets dotted paths by design. Classified as style; statix stays advisory.

--no-build and IFD: check-ci predicted --no-build passes while building IFD; map conflict 14 said pure eval allows IFD. Measured: --no-build fails cold and passes warm (state-dependent). Only allow-import-from-derivation false is deterministic (Q5).

Remote-ref `-source is not valid`: outputs-contract blamed 2.35 lazy copies; check-ci blamed --no-build refusing self. Measured: reproduces on 2.31.5 and Lix, plain eval succeeds, and a warm rerun passes. It is --no-build on a cold store, a checker limit.
flake-checker exit semantics: check-ci said only the Action exits 0. Measured: the CLI also exits 0 on findings; --fail-mode exits 1 on findings and on crashes, so stderr classification is required.
Generator root-nixpkgs MUST (check-ci #9) vs map conflict 3: the map wins. Never add an unused input for flake-checker; the ocx flake has nixpkgs anyway for fetchurl.

Version floor: check-ci and the audit said nix_2_27 is the oldest real version. Measured: the only non-stub versions are nix_2_31, nix_2_34, nix_2_35 (nix_2_30 throws). The floor is computed by expression.

Lix divergences: check-ci said the float without a leading zero is forbidden. Measured: warning only, exit 0. The dive's rec-merge fixture also fails on CppNix; the reversed order is the true CppNix-accepts/Lix-rejects case.
Axis 7 inconclusive: a sequential rerun passes jj and zig-overlay on 2.35.2, 2.31.5 and Lix. Lix stays non-blocking (map conflict 11 confirmed).
Map conflict 6's deadnix SHOULD-until-measured: the promotion criterion is met (34 survivors after -L on six exemplars, zero caller-breaking fixes), so deadnix is promoted to MUST.
treefmt --ci in a devShell (format-and-lint) vs a nix fmt check: chose `nix fmt -- --ci` (no devShell dependency, crane precedent, verified).
NixOS/nix#5302 dirty-tree on shallow detached PR checkouts: not reproduced on 2.35.2. No checkout rule needed.
needs_another_round: gates/ci-live — run the ci-good workflow on real GitHub runners. Does cache-nix-action v7 or magic-nix-cache-action v15 restore a Rust flake closure faster and within the 10 GB cache cap after the 2025 API change, and do ubuntu-24.04-arm and macos-15 finish the gate within budget?

gates/eval-budget (M-F-18) — what wall-time budget should CI enforce for `nix flake check --all-systems --no-build`, and how is a network-bound input fan-out (helix) told apart from a silent hang (nix-installer, treefmt-nix)?

flakes/outputs-contract follow-up — adopt V15 (remote-ref `-source is not valid` is --no-build on a cold store, reproduces on 2.31.5 and Lix) and drop the lazy-copy hypothesis and the 'alias + self src is known-bad' rule.
toolchain (infra, not research) — add a stale sqlite dotfile-lock guard to run.sh before the next wave; retro entry filed at .agents/retro/inbox/20260927T101137Z-27acfc3a.json in the main checkout.

top_rules: FOD outputHash = the OCI layer digest converted to SRI, outputHashMode stays default "flat" — no prefetch, ever
Fetch header is the fixed literal `Authorization: Bearer QQ==`, never a per-build token-exchange call — confirmed live against a third-party org, not just Homebrew's
Never pass --location-trusted; curl's default (post-CVE-2018-1000007) plus the OCI spec's own MUST already stop Authorization crossing to the SAS-signed redirect host
Generation needs registry access TWICE per (package, platform) — manifest for the layer digest, then a separate blob fetch for the config (env/entrypoints/binaries); eval time needs zero
Resolve env/entrypoints/binaries per platform, never once per package — cmake's Linux bin/ vs Darwin .app-bundle PATH are genuinely different values
meta.mainProgram only when binaries has exactly one entry — nixpkgs has no array equivalent, so never guess for multi-binary packages like cmake
meta.license via lib.getLicenseFromSpdxId (nixpkgs' own resolver) — no hand-rolled SPDX table, and omit meta.license entirely for the 7.4% with no annotation
Linux glibc-tagged packages get autoPatchelfHook + stdenv.cc.cc.lib; bare/static packages get neither — confirmed by readelf against real binaries, not assumed from the os.features tag alone
surprises: The Homebrew placeholder header `Authorization: Bearer QQ==` is not Homebrew-specific: it worked identically live against ocx-contrib/actionlint, a completely unrelated org — ghcr.io accepts it for any public package's anonymous pull, eliminating the token-exchange step conflict 16 still treated as the likely fallback

Flake generation needs TWO registry hops per (package, platform), not one as conflict 17 implied — the config blob (env/entrypoints/binaries) sits at a separate digest from the layer, one more hop past the manifest

The same package's env/entrypoints genuinely differ by platform, not just by binary format: kitware/cmake declares PATH=${installPath}/bin on Linux but PATH=${installPath}/CMake.app/Contents/bin on Darwin — a generator resolving env once per package (not per platform) would silently mis-wrap every non-primary platform

The shared single-user Nix store was held open by 80-90+ concurrent nix processes from sibling wave-2 dives for the entire dive (confirmed via fuser on db.sqlite), blocking every nix build/eval attempt (both run.sh-wrapped and direct nix-portable) for 4+ minutes each with zero output — the in-sandbox verification (V6) could not be completed this dive despite two independent attempts

cmake's Linux binary needs autoPatchelfHook but has NO libstdc++.so.6 NEEDED entry despite being a C++ codebase (likely statically linked libstdc++), while ninja (also glibc-tagged) does need it — the glibc/dynamic split is not uniform even within the same libc tag

kitware/cmake declares five binaries (ccmake, cmake, cmake-gui, cpack, ctest) with no single mainProgram — nixpkgs structurally cannot express this, confirming M-E-11's gap is a real, not theoretical, mapping hole

top_rules: Canonicalize every package's tags by content digest before choosing a version string, never walk tags directly — re-derived exactly: 1,293 unique digests from 2,985 tags (56.7% aliasing), matching the ocx audit's number
A digest with only a vendor build-number tag (Corretto's 11.0.32_10001, no bare sibling) must still get its own version — never dropped or misfiled as an alias of the wrong digest

The overlay must add exactly one namespace attribute (final.ocx.<ns>.<pkg>), never merge unprefixed into pkgs: 79-83% of the index's 122 basenames collide with an existing nixpkgs attribute name, measured live against the nixpkgs by-name tree — far beyond the map's cmake/ninja/node example
packages.<system>.<ns>-<pkg> is latest-only and flat; every version including float aliases lives under legacyPackages.<system>.<ns>.<pkg>, which nix flake check/show never walks

The platform-to-system mapping must reuse ocx's directed compatibility relation in full (Any asymmetry, os_features inversion, tie-refused) — a naive (os,arch) lookup silently picks the wrong manifest; confirmed live that duckdb and cmake are +libc.glibc-only at linux/amd64 with no bare alternative

A fixed-output derivation's outputHash is the OCI layer digest (SRI-converted); the token-exchange-and-manifest-GET must run inside the FOD's own build, never pre-resolved into a URL, since the blob redirect is a ~10-minute SAS URL
The generator lives in ocx as a subcommand reusing platform.rs:416 and the registry client, never a second drifting reimplementation of the compatibility relation in the flake repository

The update loop should be a reviewed PR under a GitHub App token gated by a smoke build, not a direct push — nix flake check --all-systems --no-build never validates a fixed-output hash, and ocx has no publisher-signature verification yet (M-E-20 open)
surprises: The index shadows nixpkgs at a scale the map understated by an order of magnitude: 96/122 (79%) basenames match an nixpkgs pkgs/by-name entry verbatim, plus 5+ more in the legacy tree (neovim, shellcheck, kustomize, pnpm, zig), pushing it to 101/122 (83%) — not just the 3-name example (cmake/ninja/node) the topic map cited

Basename collisions inside the index itself are narrow: only 'cli' collides, across exactly 4 namespaces (github, gitlab, grimoire, ocx) — confirmed exhaustively over all 125 packages, not a spot check

Data size is a non-issue at current scale: even the richest scenario (all 1,293 digests x all ~5.3 platforms each) projects to only ~2.1 MiB, two orders of magnitude under the 20 MB rolling-window trigger owner Q5 worried about

The eval-time-as-flake=false-input alternative breaks for a sharper reason than 'IFD is forbidden': the manifest-fetching derivation can't be a fixed-output derivation (its own hash is the unknown being discovered), so the sandbox denies it network access before IFD's own gate is even reached

The shared Nix store was saturated by 100+ concurrent processes from other wave-2 dive workers for the entire session — even a bare 'nix --version' timed out at 60s with 0% CPU used — so several nix-command verifications (flake check, build, eval) could not be completed and are honestly reported as NOT RUN with verbatim rerun commands, while the load-bearing findings (canonicalization, the live 5-package ghcr.io registry probe, the nixpkgs-shadowing census) were obtained without the toolchain and are fully verified

A live, credential-free probe of 5 packages (actionlint, age, github/cli, duckdb, cmake) via ghcr.io's anonymous bearer-token exchange succeeded end-to-end, confirming duckdb and cmake are +libc.glibc-only at linux/amd64 with no bare manifest alternative — extending the ocx audit's single-package (actionlint) probe to 5 and reproducing the map's M4 glibc-only list live

rule_ids: NIX-GEN-01 — Commit the generated data file and read it with fromJSON/readFile; never fetch registry or index data during evaluation
NIX-GEN-02 — Generate the data with an ocx subcommand that reuses platform.rs:416 and ocx's registry client; the flake repo holds no platform logic
NIX-GEN-03 — Group tags by content digest into one canonical version per digest, with the rest as aliases; never drop a digest
NIX-GEN-04 — Map offers to Nix systems through ocx's directed relation with host {libc.glibc}; drop musl-only, windows and darwin/amd64 (nixpkgs >=26.11) offers; never first-match on (os, arch)
NIX-GEN-05 — Resolve the manifest and config blob per (package, platform) at generation time; never copy env, binaries or strip_components across platforms

NIX-GEN-06 — Put only the latest version in flat packages.<system>.<ns>-<pkg>; put every version and alias in legacyPackages.<system>.<ns>.<pkg>."<version>"; omit a package on systems it does not offer rather than throw
NIX-GEN-07 — Make the overlay add exactly one attribute, ocx, built against final; never merge generated names into pkgs
NIX-GEN-08 — Fetch layers with nixpkgs fetchurl and curlOptsList ["-H" "Authorization: Bearer QQ=="]; never a header-less fetch; token-exchange FOD or skopeo only as fallback
NIX-GEN-09 — Set hash to the OCI layer digest verbatim (sha256:<hex>), stored once; no SRI copy, no prefetch, no builtins.convertHash
NIX-GEN-10 — Never commit a resolved SAS blob URL, --location-trusted, or lib.fakeHash
NIX-GEN-11 — Apply autoPatchelfHook plus stdenv.cc.cc.lib to every Linux package, whatever its libc tag
NIX-GEN-12 — Always set meta.sourceProvenance = [ binaryNativeCode ] and meta.platforms
NIX-GEN-13 — Set meta.mainProgram only when exactly one binary is declared; never guess

NIX-GEN-14 — Have the generator split SPDX expressions into ids; map each with getLicenseFromSpdxIdOr and a stub fallback; omit meta.license when the annotation is missing; never getLicenseFromSpdxId on the raw string
NIX-GEN-15 — Gate every update on a sandboxed smoke check that runs the binaries, on top of flake check --no-build; --rebuild changed FODs on a warm store
NIX-GEN-16 — Land updates as a reviewed PR under a GitHub App token, one item's failure non-fatal; never direct-push until signatures are verified
NIX-GEN-17 — Keep every digest and emit data.json deterministically (sorted keys); revisit pruning only past 20 MB
NIX-GEN-18 — When the index populates status: keep yanked versions in legacyPackages only, lib.warn deprecated ones; invent no signal before then
conflicts_resolved: Fetch transport: index-data-model and the ocx audit said token exchange inside the FOD and never a plain fetchurl; oci-fetch-prototype said fetchurl with a fixed QQ== header. Resolved for fetchurl+QQ==: a sandboxed nix build --rebuild went red without the header (401) and green with it.

Hash storage: the prototype stored layerDigest plus an SRI copy, and map Q18 converts. Resolved: store the digest once and pass it verbatim as hash. CppNix 2.35.2 and Lix 2.95.2 evaluate it to the same drv; a drift twin gives a hash mismatch; builtins.convertHash is rejected because Lix 2.95.2 lacks it.
Failure signature of a wrong digest: both dives predicted 'hash mismatch'. Measured: a 404, because the URL carries the digest; a mismatch appears only when a second hash copy drifts.

autoPatchelf: the prototype applied it to glibc-tagged offers only. Resolved: every Linux package gets it. On a static ELF it is a measured no-op ('skipping ... statically linked', identical 6-path closure), and libc tagging drifts over time.

License: the prototype used getLicenseFromSpdxId. Overruled: 231/1720 annotations are SPDX expressions and PSF-2.0 and GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0 do not map, so every eval warns (watched red under abort-on-warn). Resolved: the generator splits expressions and the reader uses getLicenseFromSpdxIdOr with a stub.

Missing license: nixpkgs pkgs/README.md:503-505 defaults to unfree, while the prototype omits. Resolved: omit plus an ADR request. All 8 latest-version gaps are OSS (bazel family, regclient, ocx/cli, grimoire/cli), so the gap is metadata, not licensing.
mainProgram: map Q7 requires it unconditionally; NIX-GEN-06 of the prototype sets it only for one binary. Resolved: for shape D it is conditional on exactly one binary, per pkgs/README.md:508-515.

Attribute naming: index-data-model §6 sketches 'cli-github', while conflict 18 and the prototype use <ns>-<pkg>. Resolved: <ns>-<pkg>, with legacyPackages.<ns>.<pkg>."<ver>" (no extra ocx level) so #kitware.cmake."4.4.2" resolves; unquoted fails (measured).

Update loop: direct push (zig-overlay, fenix, nix-index-database update.yml:158-162) vs reviewed PR (terraform, python). Resolved: reviewed PR with an App token until M-E-20 signature verification exists.

Generation hops: conflict 17 said one registry hop; the prototype measured two per (package, platform), manifest plus config blob, and index-data-model put the manifest GET inside the FOD. Resolved: two hops, both at generation time; the FOD does only the blob GET.
Q20 form: the map's getFlake --impure expression was replaced by a pure nix eval .#overlays.default --apply with jq -e '. == ["ocx"]', watched red and green.
